Name: 'Dragon to Ride'  Dragon wing audio
Author: BlueCynder
Description:
[center][b][size=5][color=#ffff00]ONLY AVAILABLE FOR VERSION 1.5 AT THE MOMENT UNTIL REQUIRED MODS ARE HOPEFULLY UPDATED[/color]

This is a mod that adds dragon wing audio for the mod [/size][color=#ff7700][size=5][u]Dragon to Ride[/u][/size][/color][size=5] by [/size][/b][color=#ff7700][b][size=5]Kyuya258369[/size][/b]
[/color][size=3]Here is the link to Dragon to Ride[b]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5679][color=#b6d7a8]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5679

[/color][/url][/b][/size][/center]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][b][u]IMPORTANT INFO, MOD WON'T WORK WELL IF IGNORED:
[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]The only unfortunate side to my mod, is that if you download it you have to go into the [b][i]content.JSON[/i][/b] to manually put in your dragons/horses name so that it works. For example:
 
"Id": "thudStep",
"Conditions": "LC Game1.player.isRidingHorse() and string.find(Game1.player.mount.Name,'[b][i]Insert Dragons/Horses Name[/i][/b]') ~= nil",
 
"Id": "stoneStep",
"Conditions": "LC Game1.player.isRidingHorse() and string.find(Game1.player.mount.Name,'[b][i]Insert [/i][/b][b][i]Dragons/Horses[/i][/b][b][i] Name[/i][/b]') ~= nil",
 
"Id": "woodyStep",
"Conditions": "LC Game1.player.isRidingHorse() and string.find(Game1.player.mount.Name,'[b][i]Insert [/i][/b][b][i]Dragons/Horses[/i][/b][b][i] Name[/i][/b]') ~= nil", [/size]






[center][font=Arial][size=4][b]Thank you Kyuya for making such an amazing mod!
I hope my audio addition helps your immersion and Stardew Valley entertainment~

[/b][/size][/font][/center]
